name: Sports
summary: Live NFL & NBA scores, schedules, standings and players by voice
description: Your live sports companion. Ask what games are on, check live scores and box scores, follow your team, read standings, look up any player, and get the latest headlines — NFL and NBA — in a native scoreboard you can tap through. No setup and no login: it works the moment you install it.

tools.name: sports_scores
tools.title: Live scores
tools.description: Live and recent scores as a tappable native scoreboard (tap a game for the box score). "What games are on", "NFL scores", "did the Lakers win". Read-only.

league.description: "nfl" or "nba". Inferable from a team name.

team.description: Optional team to focus on, e.g. "49ers", "Lakers".

date.description: Optional day YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today / current week.

tools.name: sports_game
tools.title: Box score
tools.description: Full detail for one game — score by quarter, leaders, betting line, live win probability. "How did the Chiefs game go", "box score". Give a team or a game id. Read-only.

league.description: "nfl" or "nba". Inferable from a team name.

team.description: A team in the game, e.g. "Chiefs".

game_id.description: ESPN event id from a sports_scores result (optional).

tools.name: sports_schedule
tools.title: Schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games. "What games are on tonight", "when do the Warriors play next", "NBA schedule". With a team, that team's schedule; without one, the league slate. Read-only.

league.description: "nfl" or "nba". Inferable from a team name.

tools.name: sports_team
tools.title: Team update
tools.description: A quick team update: record, division standing, next game and last result, with the logo. "How are the 49ers doing", "Lakers record". Read-only.

league.description: "nfl" or "nba". Inferable from a team name.

tools.name: sports_standings
tools.title: Standings
tools.description: League standings as a ranked table with logos, records, win pct and streak. "NFL standings", "NBA West standings". Optional conference/division filter. Read-only.

tools.name: sports_player
tools.title: Player card
tools.description: A player card: position, team, jersey and current-season stat line, with headshot. "Patrick Mahomes stats", "how is LeBron doing". Read-only.

tools.name: sports_news
tools.title: Headlines
tools.description: Latest NFL or NBA headlines, tappable to the full story. "Sports news", "what's happening in the NBA". Read-only.
